name: OBB head (oriented boxes)

whatIsIt.eli5: Draws boxes that can turn, so a tilted thing gets a tight box.
whatIsIt.simple: A Detect head plus one extra output per cell: the rotation angle of the box. Useful for images taken from above, like drone or satellite photos.
whatIsIt.engineer: Detect + cv4[i] → ne = 1 angle channel; rotated boxes (x, y, w, h, θ), trained with ProbIoU.

whyExists.eli5: A straight box around a tilted row of plants would also cover lots of soil.
whyExists.simple: Axis-aligned boxes fit rotated objects poorly and overlap each other; an angle gives a tight fit.
whyExists.engineer: Rotated boxes reduce background inside boxes and overlap between dense, oriented objects (aerial imagery).

eli5: Also guess how much each box is turned.
simple: Box and class branches as in Detect.
cv4 predicts one angle value per cell.
In v8/11 the angle is (sigmoid(a) − 0.25)·π, a range of −π/4 to 3π/4.
engineer: YOLO26 (OBB26) outputs the raw angle and adds a dedicated angle loss.

pytorch: self.cv4 = nn.ModuleList(nn.Sequential(Conv(x, c4, 3), Conv(c4, c4, 3), nn.Conv2d(c4, ne, 1)) for x in ch)
